story_note: Isla begins her Wednesday calm and focused with a new Sapiver Press Suite puzzle, welcoming the fresh challenge.
continuation_note: After steady progress and thoughtful pauses, she reaches a key insight and concludes with plans to return tomorrow.

scenes.title: Opening Grid
scenes.beat: Isla opens today's real puzzle and takes in the starting pattern
scenes.dialogue: Alright, let's see what we have today.
scenes.caption: Isla studies the blank grid, the start of a new challenge.
scenes.screen_state: initial puzzle grid with clues visible but no answers filled in

scenes.title: First Moves
scenes.beat: The first safe entries create a foothold
scenes.dialogue: These first answers give me some ground.
scenes.caption: Safe entries begin to take shape on the grid.
scenes.screen_state: puzzle grid with several answers filled in confidently

scenes.title: Stuck Moment
scenes.beat: A fair pause before forcing anything
scenes.dialogue: Time to pause; no hasty guesses.
scenes.caption: Isla reflects, avoiding guesses and thinking through logic.
scenes.screen_state: puzzle grid showing some unsolved spaces and notes, indicating thoughtful consideration

scenes.title: Breakthrough
scenes.beat: One clean deduction changes the board
scenes.caption: A key move unlocks more of the puzzle.
scenes.screen_state: puzzle grid with a major new section revealed or solved

scenes.title: Nearly There
scenes.beat: The puzzle is mostly filled and the logic is tightening
scenes.caption: The puzzle nears completion, logic lines tightening.
scenes.screen_state: puzzle grid mostly filled with few unsolved cells remaining

scenes.title: Finished
scenes.beat: The solved or latest real progress screen closes the strip
scenes.dialogue: Great progress today. Same time tomorrow?
scenes.caption: Closing the puzzle in the morning light, eager for next time.
scenes.screen_state: puzzle grid fully solved or showing latest progress with confident completion

style_rules: Isla is the only active daily comic character.
Puzzle screen must come from a real captured puzzle page.
No masthead inside individual scene art.
Sapiver Press logo/title only on merchandise and monitor/browser URL.
Story text must continue from previous episode, not repeat a fixed template.
Puzzle screen must be composited from real capture, not invented by image generation.
The scene should be comic illustration, not photorealism.
